title: Holding a conversation
goal: Hold a conversation mixing narrative, opinion, argument and clarification.

turns.reading: chàbuduō. duì le, nǐ zhōumò yǒu kòng ma? yìqǐ chī fàn liáoliao.
turns.phon: chah-boo-dwoh. dway luh, nee joh-moh yoh koong mah? ee-chee chr fahn lyow-lyow.
turns.native: Pretty much. By the way, are you free this weekend? Let's have a meal and talk it over.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 你的西安之行怎么样？
turns.reading: nǐ de Xī'ān zhī xíng zěnmeyàng?
turns.phon: nee duh shee-ahn jr shing dzun-muh-yahng?
turns.native: How was your trip to Xi'an?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 太好了！最让我感动的是那里的人，特别热情。
turns.reading: tài hǎo le! zuì ràng wǒ gǎndòng de shì nàlǐ de rén, tèbié rèqíng.
turns.phon: teye how luh! dzway rahng woh gahn-doong duh shr nah-lee duh run, tuh-byeh ruh-ching.
turns.native: Wonderful! What moved me most was the people there, so warm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 你坐高铁去的吗？
turns.reading: nǐ zuò gāotiě qù de ma?
turns.phon: nee dzwoh gow-tyeh chyu duh mah?
turns.native: Did you take the high-speed train?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 对，五个小时。先去了兵马俑，然后在老城走了一天。
turns.reading: duì, wǔ ge xiǎoshí. xiān qù le Bīngmǎyǒng, ránhòu zài lǎo chéng zǒu le yì tiān.
turns.phon: dway, oo guh shyow-shr. shyen chyu luh bing-mah-yoong, rahn-hoh dzeye low chung dzoh luh ee tyen.
turns.native: Yes, five hours. First the Terracotta Army, then a whole day walking around the old town.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 我觉得坐飞机更快。
turns.reading: wǒ juéde zuò fēijī gèng kuài.
turns.phon: woh jyweh-duh dzwoh fay-jee gung kwye.
turns.native: I think flying is faster.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 是没错，但是高铁更方便，而且可以看风景。
turns.reading: shì méi cuò, dànshì gāotiě gèng fāngbiàn, érqiě kěyǐ kàn fēngjǐng.
turns.phon: shr may tswoh, dahn-shr gow-tyeh gung fahng-byen, ar-chyeh kuh-ee kahn fung-jing.
turns.native: That's true, but the high-speed train is more convenient, and you can see the scenery.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 如果我理解得对，你觉得慢一点也值得？
turns.reading: rúguǒ wǒ lǐjiě de duì, nǐ juéde màn yìdiǎn yě zhíde?
turns.phon: roo-gwoh woh lee-jyeh duh dway, nee jyweh-duh mahn ee-dyen yeh jr-duh?
turns.native: If I understand correctly, you think it's worth it even if it's a bit slower?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 对。一方面便宜，另一方面不用去机场。
turns.reading: duì. yì fāngmiàn piányi, lìng yì fāngmiàn búyòng qù jīchǎng.
turns.phon: dway. ee fahng-myen pyen-ee, ling ee fahng-myen boo-yoong chyu jee-chahng.
turns.native: Yes. On the one hand it's cheaper, on the other you don't have to go to the airport.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 好吧，下次我也试试。好了，我得走了，回头见！
turns.reading: hǎo ba, xià cì wǒ yě shìshi. hǎo le, wǒ děi zǒu le, huítóu jiàn!
turns.phon: how bah, shyah tsuh woh yeh shr-shr. how luh, woh day dzoh luh, hway-toh jyen!
turns.native: Alright, I'll try it next time too. Well, I have to go, see you later!

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 回头见，路上小心！
turns.reading: huítóu jiàn, lùshang xiǎoxīn!
turns.phon: hway-toh jyen, loo-shahng shyow-sheen!
turns.native: See you later, safe trip home!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 李太太，您好。我想跟您说一件事。
turns.reading: Lǐ tàitai, nín hǎo. wǒ xiǎng gēn nín shuō yí jiàn shì.
turns.phon: lee teye-teye, neen how. woh shyahng gun neen shwoh ee jyen shr.
turns.native: Hello, Mrs. Li. I'd like to talk to you about something.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 您说。
turns.reading: nín shuō.
turns.phon: neen shwoh.
turns.native: Go ahead.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 最近晚上楼上声音比较大，孩子睡不着。
turns.reading: zuìjìn wǎnshang lóushàng shēngyīn bǐjiào dà, háizi shuì bu zháo.
turns.phon: dzway-jeen wahn-shahng loh-shahng shung-een bee-jyow dah, heye-dzuh shway boo jow.
turns.native: Lately in the evenings it's been rather loud upstairs, the kids can't sleep.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 不好意思！是我儿子在练钢琴。
turns.reading: bù hǎoyìsi! shì wǒ érzi zài liàn gāngqín.
turns.phon: boo how-ee-suh! shr woh ar-dzuh dzeye lyen gahng-cheen.
turns.native: Oh, I'm sorry! That's my son practicing the piano.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 我不是这个意思，我是说能不能早一点练？
turns.reading: wǒ bú shì zhège yìsi, wǒ shì shuō néng bu néng zǎo yìdiǎn liàn?
turns.phon: woh boo shr juh-guh ee-suh, woh shr shwoh nung boo nung dzow ee-dyen lyen?
turns.native: That's not what I mean, I'm saying: could he practice a bit earlier?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 话是这么说，不过他六点才放学。
turns.reading: huà shì zhème shuō, búguò tā liù diǎn cái fàngxué.
turns.phon: hwah shr juh-muh shwoh, boo-gwoh tah lyoh dyen tseye fahng-shyweh.
turns.native: That's one way to put it, but he doesn't get out of school until six.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 如果我理解得对，您觉得八点以前比较难？
turns.reading: rúguǒ wǒ lǐjiě de duì, nín juéde bā diǎn yǐqián bǐjiào nán?
turns.phon: roo-gwoh woh lee-jyeh duh dway, neen jyweh-duh bah dyen ee-chyen bee-jyow nahn?
turns.native: If I understand correctly, you think before eight is rather difficult?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 对。但是九点以后不练，可以吗？
turns.reading: duì. dànshì jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu bú liàn, kěyǐ ma?
turns.phon: dway. dahn-shr jyoh dyen ee-hoh boo lyen, kuh-ee mah?
turns.native: Yes. But no practicing after nine, would that work?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 可以，太好了。总的来说，问题不大。
turns.reading: kěyǐ, tài hǎo le. zǒng de lái shuō, wèntí bú dà.
turns.phon: kuh-ee, teye how luh. dzoong duh leye shwoh, wun-tee boo dah.
turns.native: Yes, that's great. All in all, it's not a big problem.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: 谢谢您的理解。代我问候您家人！
turns.reading: xièxie nín de lǐjiě. dài wǒ wènhòu nín jiārén!
turns.phon: shyeh-shyeh neen duh lee-jyeh. deye woh wun-hoh neen jyah-run!
turns.native: Thank you for understanding. Say hello to your family for me!

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: You can keep up a long conversation: tell a story with time markers and feelings (那时候, 真的很…), weigh pros and cons (一方面… 另一方面…), concede then object (是没错，但是… / 话是这么说，不过…), restate the other person's view (如果我理解得对), hold or clarify your own (我还是觉得, 我不是这个意思), change the subject (对了), sum up (总的来说) and take your leave warmly.
